name: After dark
summary: A members' training club after dark: black ground, one black-and-white portrait running to the page's right edge, and the club's count (usual, or live from the door) set as one number so large it crosses the portrait's edge and turns to negative over it. Then the Hyrox race plan, and heat and cold as the warm second act in colour: steam over the stones and the cedar room. Epilogue alone, light and large. A drawn H whose crossbar rises like a slope is the mark. Few words. For premium gyms and health clubs.
